name: Algebra 1 Practice Course Profile
role: Course-specific Practice behavior using the recurrence map, approved Bank families, and two teacher-editable target plans per section.
question_structure_rule: Use current universal Question Structure for authored Practice questions except where a direct family route already owns a simple direct job.
student_label_rule: Every targeted question shows exact I Can code + full exact I Can statement near the top-left.

source_maps.bank: approved canonical Bank family records for selected I Cans

set_architecture.current_intro_rule: Normally include four current Intro questions using a useful variety of the current section's four Intro I Cans/families.
set_architecture.recurrence_rule: Use the remaining 8-12 slots on a deliberate mixture of Review/Mastery I Cans from multiple Mastery Goals according to the recurrence map. Current Mastery gets meaningful emphasis but does not automatically own the whole block.

target_plan_A.rule: Both use the same selected I Can/count plan; Activity Set 1 is a fresh sibling instance set, not an exact copy.

target_plan_B.rule: Use a second selected I Can/count plan with intentional overlap on high-priority recurrence targets and rebalanced counts/targets for broader spacing.

teacher_set_builder.direction: A teacher Set Builder should open with recommended Target Plan A and B derived from the recurrence map.
teacher_set_builder.teacher_rule: The system recommends a complete build first; the teacher edits it rather than building the curriculum plan from scratch.
teacher_set_builder.request_override_rule: A valid teacher-approved Set Builder request overrides generic defaults while preserving exact learning/evidence authority.

offline_generation.rule: When approved family generator metadata is sufficient, assemble questions locally/deterministically from stored target plan + seed/parameters. Use semantic authoring only where a family is not safely generatable.
offline_generation.reproducibility: Store family_id and seed/parameters in the source map for generated questions.

standalone_optional_tools.cyu: Optional standalone generator; not part of the required initial Practice build.
standalone_optional_tools.tarsia: Optional standalone generator; not part of the required initial Practice build.
standalone_optional_tools.blooket: Optional standalone/game generator; not part of the required initial Practice build.
standalone_optional_tools.repeat_concern: These lower-stakes standalone generators may use approved Bank families without driving strict cross-artifact freshness quotas or Bank family counts.

retired_requirements: 8 Intro + 8 Review + 8 Mastery fixed block counts
required CYU in the initial Practice build
required Tarsia in the initial Practice build
required Blooket in the initial Practice build
Practice Set 2 / Practice Set 3 as required curriculum products

freshness.parallel_rule: Same-family fresh siblings are expected when the pair architecture calls for them.
